notes.note: Re-reviewed the conditional merge-queue decision/aggregate claims after scripts typechecking exposed three fixture errors. Optional inferred manifest fields now use property-presence narrowing, and intentionally invalid schema fixtures reach the actual validator through Reflect.apply rather than a valid-domain cast. Prior369-test pin repair and missing-planRED/restored controls retain their source scope. No cast laundering, production test seam, predicate/threshold relaxation or hosted/canonical success claim. FullcurrentCI and normalpublication/hostedqueue acceptance still required.
